stories.title: Doppia tromba d'aria a Marsala: auto capovolte e feriti. Le immagini impressionanti

en.title: Double tornado in Marsala: overturned cars and injured. Striking images
en.summary: Two tornadoes struck Marsala, causing vehicles to overturn and injuring people. A school building also sustained severe damage.

stories.title: Doppia tromba marina nel Trapanese, danni e feriti

en.title: Double waterspout in the Trapani area, damage and injuries
en.summary: Two waterspouts occurred in the Trapani region, with a struck car falling into a ravine and two people hospitalized.

stories.title: Premio Nobel per la Pace 2026 alla giudice della Cpi Navanethem Pillay

en.title: 2026 Nobel Peace Prize awarded to ICC judge Navanethem Pillay
en.summary: The Nobel Institute in Oslo announced that ICC judge Navanethem Pillay won the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize for her courage and integrity against war crimes.

stories.title: Borsa: l'Europa allunga il passo, Milano +0,98% e spread in discesa a 105 punti

en.title: Stock market: Europe advances, Milan +0.98% and spread declines to 105 points
en.summary: European equity markets gained with Milan rising 0.98% while the spread narrowed. Brent oil and European government bond yields also declined.

stories.title: Il fungo gigantesco del tornado: doppia tromba marina nel trapanese, danni e feriti

en.title: The giant fungus of the tornado: double waterspout in the Trapani area, damage and injuries
en.summary: Two waterspouts formed over the sea and moved onto land in the Trapani region, causing damage and injuring people.

stories.title: Gasolio a 2,19 nei distributori Eni: la compagnia abbassa ancora il prezzo consigliato

en.title: Diesel at 2.19 euros at Eni distributors: the company lowers the recommended price again
en.summary: Eni reduced its recommended diesel price to 2.19 euros per liter, with the ceiling now at 2.25 euros after the removal of fuel tax discounts.

stories.title: Legge elettorale, gli italiani non la conoscono: tre su quattro ignorano la riforma

en.title: Electoral law, Italians don't know it: three out of four ignore the reform
en.summary: A majority of Italians are unfamiliar with a new electoral law reform, though approval rises to 41% after learning its main provisions, with strong support for voting rights for those living abroad.

stories.title: Borse, Milano apre in rosso, unica in Europa; in lieve calo petrolio e spread

en.title: Stock markets, Milan opens in red, alone in Europe; oil and spread slightly lower
en.summary: Milan's stock market opened lower while other European bourses in London, Frankfurt, and Paris rose around 0.8%, with oil and the spread declining marginally.

stories.title: Eni taglia ancora il prezzo del gasolio, torna a 2,19 euro

en.title: Eni cuts diesel price again, returns to 2.19 euros
en.summary: Eni reduced diesel prices to 2.19 euros per liter. The price cap remains set at 2.25 euros per liter.

stories.title: Scontri Askatasuna, perquisizioni in tutta Italia, chieste 19 misure

en.title: Askatasuna clashes, searches across Italy, 19 measures requested
en.summary: Police conducted an operation related to incidents during a January 31 demonstration. Authorities requested 19 measures against those involved.

stories.title: Maxi furto di vini pregiati da 5 milioni nell'azienda Marchesi Antinori a Cortona

en.title: Major theft of fine wines worth 5 million from Marchesi Antinori company in Cortona
en.summary: Thieves stole 30,000 bottles of prestigious wines from a Tuscan vineyard, disabling security systems and using company equipment to load the wine onto trucks.

stories.title: Nobel per la pace alla sudafricana Navi Pillay: se applaudite più forte, potrei dividerlo con Trump

en.title: Nobel Peace Prize awarded to South African Navi Pillay: if you applaud louder, I could share it with Trump
en.summary: South African Navi Pillay received the Nobel Peace Prize for her work ensuring prosecution of war crimes, crimes against humanity, and genocide. The committee framed the award as a message against threats to international law.

stories.title: Giù la produzione industriale (-1,3%), frenata da moda e chimica

en.title: Industrial production down (-1.3%), slowed by fashion and chemicals
en.summary: Italy's industrial production declined 1.3% in August according to Istat data, with no annual variation, returning to levels from a year earlier.

stories.title: Data center, in Italia investimenti potenziali per 37 miliardi di euro

en.title: Data centers, potential investments of 37 billion euros in Italy
en.summary: Italy's data center sector could attract 37 billion euros in potential investments driven by artificial intelligence demand, though operators cite regulatory certainty as a key obstacle.

stories.title: Ansaldo energia incorpora Nucleare come business unit

en.title: Ansaldo Energia incorporates Nuclear as business unit
en.summary: Ansaldo Energia's board approved the merger of Ansaldo Nucleare through incorporation, creating a dedicated Nuclear business unit within the company.

stories.title: Ex Ilva, stop temporaneo per l’area a caldo. Pronto un decreto Cig da 125 milioni

en.title: Ex Ilva, temporary halt for hot section. Decree ready with 125 million euro CIG
en.summary: A temporary stoppage is being implemented at the ex-Ilva hot section, with government preparing a 125 million euro extraordinary wage guarantee fund for approximately 4,200 workers.

stories.title: Crisi Hormuz, traffico merci in calo sui porti di Genova e Ravenna

en.title: Hormuz Crisis, freight traffic declines at Genoa and Ravenna ports
en.summary: Italian ports including Genoa and Ravenna are experiencing reduced cargo traffic due to geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and the ongoing conflict in Ukraine.
